$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document, NOT from FinSight output.
A SCANNED exchange filing: standalone cash flow statement, INR crore,
unseparated figures. The filer's OCR layer splits or damages figures
read from the render and every section re-added.
Two profit-before-tax lines: before regulatory deferral balances (22556.93,
the PBT of the income statement) and INCLUDING their movements (19045.00).
The second is a differently qualified figure and is not 'profit before
tax' (metric null). The adjustments' subtotal (28575.06) is unlabelled.
Working-capital lines are movements, never balances (metric null).

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.

transcription.method: read by eye from the render; positions from the filer's OCR layer
transcription.verified_against: page render at 200 dpi and the statement's own totals
